principle: Competent navigation and responsible action are not professional licensure. Use local law, consent, supervision and accessible alternatives.

L01.readiness: Grounding with trusted support; independent planning after basic literacy and numeracy
L01.scope: Reflection is not diagnosis. Do not require disclosure of trauma or private values for assessment.
L01.referral: A qualified mental-health professional for persistent distress or impairment; local emergency services for immediate danger
L01.evidence_boundary: Use redacted or fictional decision records; assess process rather than compliance with an examiner's values.

L02.readiness: Supported care navigation; age-appropriate consent and safeguarding
L02.scope: No self-diagnosis, medication changes or unsupervised clinical intervention. Exercise and nutrition tasks must accommodate disability and medical restrictions.
L02.referral: Physician, pharmacist, registered dietitian or qualified mental-health professional as relevant; urgent services for emergencies
L02.evidence_boundary: Use a simulated consultation, questions and source appraisal; never grade private health outcomes.

L03.readiness: Supported dialogue before independent mediation; consent throughout
L03.scope: No compelled intimacy, disclosure or reconciliation. Do not mediate abuse as an ordinary symmetric disagreement.
L03.referral: Safeguarding lead, qualified counselor, domestic-abuse service or emergency services when safety is threatened
L03.evidence_boundary: Role-play or consented observation; protect identities and permit withdrawal.

L04.readiness: Demonstrated tool and hygiene safety before supervised practical work
L04.scope: No live mains, gas, structural modification, hazardous chemical mixing or work at height. Use manuals and local safety rules.
L04.referral: Licensed electrician, gas technician, structural engineer, poison service or emergency services as appropriate
L04.evidence_boundary: Stop at uncertainty about energy isolation, structural support, food safety or hazardous substances. Use benign simulations where necessary.

L05.readiness: Fractions, percentages, probability and contract-reading practice
L05.scope: Education is not personalized financial, tax or legal advice. No real-money speculation is required.
L05.referral: Qualified accountant, regulated fiduciary/adviser, lawyer or consumer-protection service; check credentials and conflicts
L05.evidence_boundary: Synthetic budgets and contracts; disclose fees, assumptions, jurisdiction and downside scenarios.

L06.readiness: Supervised apprenticeship before independent accountable work
L06.scope: Respect labor protections, accessibility, authorization and workplace safety. Do not use unpaid risky work as an assessment shortcut.
L06.referral: Qualified supervisor, safety officer, occupational specialist or relevant professional
L06.evidence_boundary: External standards and user acceptance matter; confidential work may be assessed through redacted evidence.

L07.readiness: Choose texts and audiences appropriate to language fluency; offer accessible media
L07.scope: Do not confuse persuasive effectiveness with truth or legitimacy. Obtain consent for recordings and protect private speech.
L07.referral: Qualified interpreter for high-stakes medical or legal communication
L07.evidence_boundary: Assess accuracy, listening and audience fit separately from accent, status or rhetorical polish.

L08.readiness: Source literacy before independent inquiry; quantitative prerequisites before causal analysis
L08.scope: No human-subject research without appropriate ethics review and consent. Public data can still create privacy risks.
L08.referral: Librarian, domain researcher, statistician or ethics review body
L08.evidence_boundary: Record sources, exclusions, uncertainty and reproducibility; do not reward unsupported certainty.

L09.readiness: Benign local computing before delegated agents or networked experiments
L09.scope: Use owned or explicitly authorized systems. No secrets in prompts; least privilege, spending limits, monitoring and rollback before delegation.
L09.referral: Security professional, system owner or data-protection officer for sensitive systems
L09.evidence_boundary: Separate unaided explanation from AI-produced output; verify recovery without the model.

L10.readiness: Local institutional literacy and primary-document reading before public action
L10.scope: Law varies by jurisdiction and date. Curriculum interpretation is not legal advice or a guarantee of rights enforcement.
L10.referral: Qualified local lawyer, legal-aid service, ombudsman or relevant public office
L10.evidence_boundary: Use current official rules, appeal routes and lawful participation; never require partisan agreement.

L11.readiness: Supported whole-work encounter before advanced comparative interpretation
L11.scope: Respect community protocols, sacred/restricted knowledge, attribution and copyright. Do not infer absence from an incomplete archive.
L11.referral: Librarian, translator, curator, tradition-bearer or appropriately authorized community expert
L11.evidence_boundary: Distinguish historical influence, interpretation, aesthetic judgment and personal preference; retain rival readings.

L12.readiness: Field safety and local orientation before independent measurement or intervention
L12.scope: Do not enter hazardous sites, disturb protected habitats or perform engineering interventions without permission and expertise.
L12.referral: Environmental professional, engineer, land manager, weather authority or emergency services
L12.evidence_boundary: Use real observations with uncertainty and seasonality; stop when weather, access or competence limits are exceeded.
